items.headline: GPT-5.2 conjectures a formula showing single-minus gluon amplitudes are not zero
items.summary: Alfredo Guevara, Alexandru Lupsasca, David Skinner, Andrew Strominger and OpenAI's Kevin Weil report that tree-level single-minus gluon amplitudes, widely assumed to vanish, are nonzero in half-collinear or complexified momentum configurations. The humans computed small cases by hand, GPT-5.2 Pro simplified them and proposed the closed-form formula for any number of gluons, and an internal OpenAI model produced a proof the authors then checked analytically against recursion relations and Weinberg's soft theorem; the paper is a preprint, not peer reviewed, and two authors are at OpenAI.
